# UKGigTax

> Free UK self-employment tax calculators and guides for gig workers in 2026/27. Covers Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Amazon Flex, Bolt Food, Just Eat, courier and taxi work. Personal Allowance £12,570, income tax 20/40/45% (Scotland 19/20/21/42/45/48%), Class 4 NI 6% then 2%, Class 2 treated as paid above £7,105 profit, Trading Allowance £1,000, VAT threshold £90,000. Mileage: cars and vans 55p for the first 10,000 business miles then 25p, motorbikes 24p, bicycles 20p.

## Key 2026/27 figures

- Personal Allowance: £12,570 (tapered £1 per £2 over £100,000)
- England, Wales, NI: 20% to £50,270, 40% to £125,140, 45% above
- Scotland: 19% to £16,537, 20% to £29,526, 21% to £43,662, 42% to £75,000, 45% to £125,140, 48% above
- Class 4 NI: 6% on £12,570–£50,270, 2% above
- Class 2 NI: £3.65/week, treated as paid when profit is at least £7,105
- Trading Allowance: £1,000 (cannot be combined with expenses)
- VAT registration threshold: £90,000 rolling 12 months; deregistration £88,000
- Payments on account: two 50% payments when the bill is £1,000+ and less than 80% is collected at source
- Mileage: cars/vans 55p first 10,000 miles then 25p; motorbikes 24p; bicycles 20p
